A commenter comparing Blackwell Ultra (B300/GB300) specs to the prior Blackwell chip was puzzled that it gets about +50% dense FP4 from what they call the same silicon while INT8 and FP64 throughput drop about 97%. They wondered whether the cause was firmware, repurposed INT8/FP64 units, or QA/certification issues.

On a review of an HGX B300 8-GPU server, a commenter noted that no price was given. They cited rough math from another thread suggesting that running your own server like this is about an order of magnitude cheaper. They also questioned how practical it is at home, guessing it wouldn't run on a 20A or even 50A circuit.
